blocks.title: Loops
blocks.text: Loops kaam dohrate hain, jis se code mukhtasar aur parhne mein aasan hota hai. Python mein do bari qismein hain: while loops aur for loops.

blocks.prompt: Python ke do bare loops bataiye.
blocks.explanation: while loop (shart sach rehne tak dohrata hai) aur for loop (sequence ki har cheez ke liye dohrata hai).

items: Loops kaam dohrate hain: while (shart se) aur for (sequence par).
